test_purpose: VCST-5730 — the rep WITH documents-library READ access. Holds the module-seeded "Advanced Sales Representative" role (sales-rep:access + sales-rep-documents:read), so it is the happy-path caller for the shared library: list/search/filter/paginate/download. Deliberately a NEW account rather than a reused rep — every rep in sales-reps.csv holds "Sales Representative" (sales-rep:access ONLY), and that no-read state is itself the permission-negative case for this feature, so it must not be changed.

VCST-5730 — the rep with documents:WRITE but NOT :read. Proves whether the deployed read gate really honours its disjunction (SalesRepDocumentPermissions.HasReadAccess = Administrator OR :read OR :write) — i.e. a write-only holder can still LIST the library. Two roles are required because POST /api/sales-rep silently falls back to a granting role when roleId names a non-granting one (ResolveAssignableRoleAsync), so "Sales Rep Documents Manager" (write only, no sales-rep:access) can never be the create-time role; it is added to the ApplicationUser afterwards and survives a reseed because UpdateAccountAsync only strips GRANTING roles.
